# mergegateway_api_key (Resource)

Manages a Merge Gateway API key, used to send requests through the Gateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mergegateway_project" "support_bot" {
  name = "Support bot"
}

# A key scoped to one project, capped at $100 a month, limited to two models.
resource "mergegateway_api_key" "support_bot" {
  name           = "Support bot production"
  project_id     = mergegateway_project.support_bot.id
  limit          = 100
  limit_reset    = "monthly"
  allowed_models = ["openai/gpt-4o", "openai/gpt-4o-mini"]
}

# An organization-wide key with no cap, which can pick a project per request
# with the X-Project-Id header.
resource "mergegateway_api_key" "internal_tools" {
  name = "Internal tools"
}

# The raw key is only known after create. Pass it on without printing it, for
# example to a secret store, or read it with `terraform output -raw`.
output "support_bot_api_key" {
  value     = mergegateway_api_key.support_bot.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_models` (Set of String) The only models the key may use, at most 200, each written as `provider/model`. A single trailing `*` matches a prefix, such as `openai/*`; model aliases aren't allowed. Leave it out to allow every model. An empty list, which the API treats as allowing no model, isn't supported: set `disabled = true` instead.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the key is disabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `limit` (Number) USD spend cap over the `limit_reset` window. Must be greater than 0. Leave it out for no cap. Once set, it can be changed but not removed: the API can't clear it yet, so a plan that removes it fails.
- `limit_reset` (String) The window `limit` applies to: `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`. Defaults to `monthly`.
- `name` (String) The key's name. Leave it out for none. Once set, it can be changed but not removed: the API can't clear it yet, so a plan that removes it fails.
- `project_id` (String) The project the key is scoped to. Leave it out for a key that can use any project. It can't be changed after creation: changing it replaces the key.
- `routing_policy_id` (String) A routing policy to bind the key to: an organization-level policy or one scoped to the key's project.

### Read-Only

- `budget_group_id` (String) The Merge for Workforce budget group the key draws down. Managed by Merge for Workforce.
- `created_at` (String) When the key was created (RFC 3339).
- `creator_user_id` (String) The dashboard user who created the key. Null for keys created with a management key, as Terraform does.
- `expires_at` (String) When the key stops working (RFC 3339). Null means it never expires. Not settable yet.
- `id` (String) The key's ID: the SHA-256 hash of the raw key.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The raw API key. The API returns it only when the key is created, so it is null after an import.
- `label` (String) The key's first characters, for display.
- `limit_remaining` (Number) `limit` minus `usage`, never below 0, as of the last refresh. Null when there is no limit.
- `usage` (Number) USD spend in the current `limit_reset` window, as of the last refresh.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a key by its hash (its ID). The API returns the raw key only when the
# key is created, so after an import `key` is null.
terraform import mergegateway_api_key.support_bot 3f2a8c0e9b7d4e1f6a5b2c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f
```
